mechanism: Module-scope subscriber set retains event listener callbacks and payload closures indefinitely after component unmount due to missing cleanup in useEffect.

evidence.claim: useEffect adds subscriber callback to module-scoped messageSubscribers Set on mount without returning a cleanup function to remove it on unmount.
After 3 mount-unmount cycles, runtimeState shows activeResources and retainedResources increased by 3 (from 0 to 3) with zero released resources.
After forced garbage collection (2 passes), used heap size increased by 486,816 bytes and backing storage increased by 786,881 bytes over baseline.

recommendedFix: Return a cleanup function from useEffect in EventBusCase to delete the subscriber from messageSubscribers when the component unmounts.
limitations: The evidence comes from a synthetic benchmark-controlled scenario, not an arbitrary production application.
Heap-size deltas are engine-sensitive and must not be treated as leak proof without a retained post-GC signal.
The bounded listener summary inspects listeners attached to window and does not replace a full heap snapshot or arbitrary retaining-path search.
